issue.title: Remaining panels lack q / Ctrl+[ close-key parity
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `bob-plugins`: `block-id-prompt/src/087-task-wikilink-picker-modal.js`, `block-id-prompt/src/085-pomodoro-link-picker-modal.js`, `bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/450-picker-keydown.js` (BulletPropertyPickerKeydownMixin), `bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/060-decay-card-modal.js`, `bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/192-freshness-refresh-summary-modal.js`

**Repro.** Open each panel and press `q` (outside any text field) or `Ctrl+[`:
- 087 wikilink picker (`block-id-prompt/src/087-task-wikilink-picker-modal.js:486,516`): `Esc` and `Ctrl+[` back out, `q` does nothing.
- 085 Pomodoro link picker (`block-id-prompt/src/085-pomodoro-link-picker-modal.js:450`): `Esc` and `Ctrl+[` close, `q` does nothing.
- Filtered pickers (`bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/450-picker-keydown.js:116`): `Ctrl+[` closes like `Esc`, `q` does nothing.
- Decay card (`bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/060-decay-card-modal.js:288,315`): `Esc` backs out, `q`/`Ctrl+[` do nothing.
- Freshness summary (`bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/192-freshness-refresh-summary-modal.js:101`): `Esc` closes, `q`/`Ctrl+[` do nothing.

Checked and excluded: delete-confirm modal (`bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/672-delete-confirm-modal.js` + `671-delete-guard-model.js:366`) cancels on any key so `q`/`Ctrl+[`/`Esc` already cancel; image zoom, Copy card, Task Card, inbox route picker, successor picker already conform.

**Impact.** Keyboard-first users hitting `q` or `Ctrl+[` in these panels get nothing (or a typed `q` in the vault/Vim macro start when focus is in the editor), violating `decisions:q-and-ctrl-bracket-mirror-esc`. Fix per panel: route `q`/`Ctrl+[` through that panel's existing `Esc` dispatch with the `q`-types-in-text-controls exception, plus the modal keymap-scope route so the keys work with editor focus; add the `256`-style unit matrix and docs line. Bob Mac Capture was not audited.

task_type_fields.impact: q/Ctrl+[ do nothing in these panels, breaking the close-key parity rule and dropping keystrokes to the vault.
task_type_fields.repro: Open each panel, focus outside any text field, press q or Ctrl+[ and compare with Esc; see /tmp/followup_desc.md for per-file lines.

issue.creation_reason: Reviewer-approved schema-card close-keys plan requires every Esc-dismissed panel to also close with q and Ctrl+[, and its step 9 asks for one bead listing the panels still missing that parity.

payload.description: Confirm the follow-up bead is filed and ready

evidence.note: From bob-cli-om.4 note #2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by bob-cli-om.land: two more panels lack q close-key parity. S12 Notebook create (bob-plugins nav src/685-plugin-notebook-create.js) and S13 Bob Mail Task from this email (bob-mail src/040-task-modal.js) close on Esc and now Ctrl+[ (om.4 closed those gaps after the LINK band layer), but q does nothing when focus is on a button. q must keep typing in their text fields. Same remediation as this task: route q through each panel's Esc dispatch per decisions:q-and-ctrl-bracket-mirror-esc.
